content.comment_body: Hello, please review the attached video. In the properties and parameters section, it displays Old password, New password, and Confirm new password. Even after clearing the program and password, the system still shows the Old password. I am trying to set a new password, but it always asks for the old one, even after using the TRANSFER feature to clear user program and password—these operations complete successfully, but when I return to PROPERTIES PARAMETERS, the old password remains. How can I set a new password on a [product_name] using [article_no]?
Is there a memory card installed in the [product_name]? If so, what type?

Hi, the old password is stored within your program. Whenever you download the program, you set this configuration. To update, go to File > Properties and select the Parameters tab in the dialog. There you can delete the password and set a new one. Hope this is useful.
Hello [user_name], whenever I enter the old password, the system reports it as incorrect even though I am sure I typed it correctly. What could be causing this issue?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulty and confusion when trying to reset or assign a new password to a [product_name] with [article_no] after attempting to clear both the user program and password. Although the procedure to clear memory and password is followed, the system still requests the old password and does not permit setting a new one. This suggests the user interface for password handling and feedback is not intuitive, leaving users unsure whether the password has been cleared and what steps to follow if the old password is still prompted or not accepted.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that clearing the user program and password would allow them to set a new password without needing the old one, and that the process should be simple and transparent.
